labels: real = unmodified ENF-WHU clips; synthetic = ffmpeg asetrate/atempo speed changes and numpy sample-exact splices of real ENF-WHU audio

ci_check_holdout.note: Bootstrap-over-sub-window 95% CI of k (speed_check.analyse), evaluated on holdout H1 clips rebuilt from the same segments (eval/ci_check.json). 'ci_covers_true_k' uses the measurement CI relative to a nominal 50.000 Hz grid; 'ci_incl_grid_band' also allows +/-0.2 Hz of grid deviation. Counted only over clips whose decision was correct.

grid_facts.statutory: ESQCR 2002 reg 27(3)(a): +/-1% of declared frequency (50 Hz) - https://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2665/regulation/27
grid_facts.operational: NESO normal operating band 49.8-50.2 Hz (Grid Code statutory band 49.5-50.5 Hz)

dataset_note: ENF-WHU recordings are from Wuhan, China (50 Hz grid), not GB; the GB band is used only to set k_tol.

counts.clips_per_recording: 1 seeded source segment per H1 recording; clips of length L are prefixes (nested). H0: 6 seeded segments per source.
